environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks within a VPC private subnet (10.200.64.0/19). The subnet route table (rtb-0a3f7c2e9b1d84560) contains only local routes (10.200.0.0/16 -> local) and a route to the VPC endpoint for ECR (vpce-0c8e3a4f1b2d96e70). There is no NAT Gateway, no NAT instance, and no Internet Gateway route associated with this subnet. VPC Flow Logs confirm zero accepted flows to non-RFC1918 destinations. The ECS task execution role (arn:aws:iam::441199283746:role/inventory-svc-task-exec) has no permissions beyond ecr:GetAuthorizationToken, ecr:BatchGetImage, and logs:PutLogEvents. Security group sg-0f2a8b4c6d1e39a70 allows inbound only from the internal ALB (sg-0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8) on port 8080, and outbound only to the VPC CIDR (10.200.0.0/16) and the CloudWatch Logs VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8). Logs are shipped directly to CloudWatch Logs via the VPC endpoint with no Elasticsearch/Kibana in the path.

config.runtime: Spring Boot 3.1.2 on ECS Fargate (AL2023 platform 1.4.0)
config.logging: Logback 1.4.8 with PatternLayout, no OWASP encoder
config.network: Private subnet 10.200.64.0/19, no NAT GW, no IGW route, no VPC peering to public subnets
config.security_group_egress: sg-0f2a8b4c6d1e39a70: allow 443 to pl-0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8 (CW Logs endpoint), allow 8080 to 10.200.0.0/16
config.dependencies: log4j-core 2.17.0 present as transitive dependency via legacy audit library
